In this regard, we have already intimated to the Exchange that, pursuant to the order dated June 13, 2025, passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench ("NCLT"), Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") has been initiated against Gensol Engineering Limited ("Corporate Debtor") under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("IBC"). Pursuant thereto, the undersigned has been appointed as the Resolution Professional ("RP") for conducting the CIRP in accordance with the provisions of the IBC and the applicable regulations. Consequent to the commencement of CIRP, the affairs of the Company are being managed in accordance with the provisions of the IBC under the supervision of the appointed Resolution Professional. The Company is presently facing significant operational, financial and administrative constraints in relation to its statutory and regulatory compliances, including the finalisation, preparation and approval of the Financial Results for the quarter/half year ended September 30, 2026. Further, due to the ongoing CIRP proceedings and the prevailing circumstances of the Corporate Debtor, the Company has been facing difficulties in arranging the requisite information, records and resources necessary for the preparation and finalisation of the Financial Results within the prescribed timelines. In view of the above circumstances, we respectfully request the Exchange to kindly take note of the Company's ongoing CIRP proceedings and consider the special circumstances under which the aforesaid delay/non- compliance has occurred. We assure the Exchange that the Company, through the Resolution Professional, shall make appropriate efforts to address the pending compliance requirements and undertake necessary steps for the preparation and submission of the Financial Results in accordance with the applicable provisions of law and the directions of the Hon'ble NCLT, wherever applicable. We request your good office to kindly take the above submission on record and consider our representation sympathetically. Thanking you. Yours faithfully, For Gensol Engineering Limited (Company under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process) The powers of the Board of Directors are suspended and are being exercised by the Resolution Professional appointed by the Hon'ble NCLT. corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: (An ISO 9001:2015; ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified company) CIN: L85110KA1954PLC000759; Website: www.sandurgroup.com Email ID: secretarial@sandurgroup.com REGISTERED OFFICE CORPORATE OFFICE ‘SATYALAYA’, No.266 ‘SANDUR HOUSE’, No.9 Ward No.1, Palace Road Bellary Road, Sadashivanagar Sandur – 583 119, Ballari District Bengaluru – 560 080 Karnataka, India Karnataka, India Tel: 08395 260300 Tel: 080 31098028 SMIORE / SEC / 2026-27 / 66 19 November 2026 BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G Dalal Street Bandra-Kurla Complex Mumbai - 400 001 Mumbai - 400 051 Scrip Code: 504918 Symbol: SANDUMA Symbol: SANDUMA Dear Sir/ Madam, Sub: Press and Media Release Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) “SEBI (LODR)” Regulations, 2015, please find attached herewith copy of the Press and Media Release titled “Sandur plans ₹280 crore beneficiation capex, targets up to 1.7 MTPA of upgraded ore output” which is being released today. Stock Exchanges are requested to kindly take the same on record. Thank you for The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited Neha Thomas Company Secretary & Compliance Officer ICSI Membership No. A60853 Encl: A/a MINES OFFICE: Deogiri - 583112, Sandur Taluk, Ballari District; Tel: 08395 271028 PLANT OFFICE: Metal & Ferroalloy Plant, Vyasankere, Mariyammanahalli – 583 222, Hosapete Taluk, Vijayanagara District; Tel: 08394 294802 / 805 Sandur plans ₹280 crore beneficiation capex, targets up to 1.7 MTPA of upgraded ore output First 3.5 MTPA unit at Deogiri is targeted for commissioning in August 2027; beneficiation process is expected to improve Fe (iron) content from about 50% to over 60%. Bengaluru, 19th November: The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited (SMIORE/the Company) (NSE: SANDUMA; BSE: 504918) plans to invest approximately ₹280 crore in its first in-mine iron ore beneficiation plant at Deogiri Village in Sandur Taluk, Ballari District, Karnataka. The first 3.5 MTPA unit is expected to produce 1.0-1.2 MTPA of upgraded iron ore initially, with potential output of up to 1.7 MTPA. The plant will process ore from SMIORE’s KTIO mines and some ore from its Deogiri mines. It is designed to upgrade lower-grade iron ore, with iron content of about 50% Fe, into concentrate with more than 60% Fe, suitable for pellet manufacturing. The project is being implemented in two phases, with a long-term plan for two 3.5 MTPA units. The first unit is currently about 25% complete, with civil works progressing, structural fabrication under way and orders for long-lead items placed. Commissioning is targeted for August 2027. The project is expected to be funded through a combination of debt and internal accruals. Bahirji A. Ghorpade, Managing Director, said “This will improve the quality and marketability of lower-grade ore, reduce waste and support better revenue realisation. The pellet plants in and around Sandur have an aggregate capacity of more than 24 MTPA. The beneficiated material could also support iron-making within the Group’s integrated steel value chain.” The mine-head location is expected to reduce the transportation of waste-bearing ore and support tailings management. The project is expected to generate 150–200 direct and indirect jobs. SMIORE reported consolidated total income of ₹1,519 crore for Q2 FY27, up 22% year on year. EBITDA increased 37% to ₹391

corporate_announcements.summary: Beta Drugs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 19, 2026, titled "Beta Drugs Limited ( Beta ) forms Oncology Joint Venture withIMGSA Groupe SPA ( IMGSA )".
corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: BDL/PKL/SEC/2026-27 19th November, 2026 To, The Manager Listing Department National Stock Exchange of India Limited Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block-G Bandra Kurla Complex Bandra East Mumbai 400051 SYMBOL: BETA Re:- Press Release Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations- Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) Dear Madam/Sir We are pleased to inform you that the Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) in Algeria. Please find enclosed a copy of the press release being issued in this regard. Kindly take the above information on record. Thanking You Your’s faithfully For Beta Drugs Ltd. Rajni Brar Company Secretary Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) JV to acquire IMGSA’s oncology formulation plant for US$8.7 million; Beta to hold 49% and manage the operations of the JV Panchkula, Nov 19th, 2026 – Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta” or “the Company”) today announced that it has entered into a joint venture (“JV”) with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”), a prominent and leading pharmaceutical and medical devices company in Algeria. Beta will hold a 49% stake in the JV, with the remaining 51% held by IMGSA (the “Transaction”). The JV will acquire IMGSA’s oncology formulation plant for a total consideration of US$8.7 million. The plant is among few plants in Algeria for manufacturing of oncology formulations and has been qualified by Algerian regulatory authority for supply in Algeria tenders. Algeria oncology market is primarily a tender market and there has been a consistent impetus provided by the government of Algeria for localisation of pharmaceutical manufacturing. From a long-standing partnership to an equity partnership IMGSA is one of Algeria’s leading healthcare companies, with an established presence across antibiotics, insulins and medical devices. The group has a diversified industrial presence in Algeria through its operations in the field of agriculture, chemicals and other industrial sectors including healthcare and pharmaceuticals. Beta has had a long-standing relationship with IMGSA over the last 4 years, during which Beta has supplied semi-finished and finished formulations to IMGSA and assisted IMGSA in product registrations for Algeria market. The product registrations would be transferred to the JV as part of the Transaction. The JV is intended to deepen the partnership between Beta and IMGSA. By moving from a supplier to an Equity investor, the two companies expect to broaden the relationship and align their long-term interests in building a strong oncology business in Algeria and North African markets. IMGSA is a leading exporter of pharmaceuticals to Tunisia, Mauritania and other North African markets and the JV will leverage the distribution network of IMGSA to cater to these markets. Transaction structure • The JV will acquire the oncology plant from IMGSA for a total consideration of US$8.7 million. • Part of the consideration to be settled by issue equity shares to IMGSA. • Beta will infuse US$ 3 Million in the JV over a period of 3 years. • Beta will transfer formulation technology to the JV as part of the Transaction . Acquisition of Oncology formulation plant As part of the Transaction, the plant being acquired by the JV has manufacturing capabilities in both injectable and oral solid dosage forms, giving the JV a broad platform to produce a range of oncology products locally i
